notes.title: JURASSIC LAND is now RELEASED !
notes.content:
We are glad to announce the release of the third world "Jurassic Land".

You can now enjoy the different activities and experiences as in the previous worlds, but now with dinosaurs. This land comes with new activities and new themes:
You can discover and interact with large set of creatures types in their routine: eating, walking, hunting, etc.

 It focuses on the life aspects of dinosaurs rather than the environment itself.
 The racing experience comes this time with a different approach: It's breathcut SURVIVING experience where you should reach the gathering point before you die.
 And many more..


We also added many improvements to the user experience. You can now choose the full experience or replaying any sub activity.

We are working hard to update with new lands and new experiences. So your feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
